description: Looks up the driver's parking: lot, status, start and end times, rate, amount so far and extensions, with a link to the driver's session page. No API key needed. Requires phone_code (the 6-character code on the driver's receipt or pass) and plate_last3 (the last 3 characters of the plate), or session_id with session_code. Any mismatch returns the same answer, SESSION_NOT_FOUND. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

phone_code.description: The 6-character phone code printed on the driver's receipt or pass

plate_last3.description: The last 3 letters or numbers of the license plate parked on the session

session_code.description: The session's code (sess_…), sent with session_id

session_id.description: Session id, from the driver's session page link. Sent with session_code.

name: get_session
title: Get a parking session
